gtp-1.source: Radford et al. 2018, 'Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training' (512 contiguous tokens)

bort.source: Devlin et al. 2018, BERT paper / google-research/bert README (max_seq_length 512)

gtp-2.source: Radford et al. 2019, 'Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners' (context size 1024)

t5x.source: Raffel et al. 2019, T5 paper (512-token input sequences)
t5x.note: Encoder-decoder; max input length. Relative position buckets allow longer inputs in principle.

meeno.note: Encoder and decoder each max 128 tokens, i.e. 256 combined; 128 is the input/context side.

lamba.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.08239 (LaMDA paper) - no context length stated
lamba.note: Paper does not give a sequence length; 2048 is an assumption based on contemporary decoder-only models (GPT-3, Gopher). Treat as placeholder.

kodex.source: OpenAI Codex announcement (Aug 2021: '14KB for Python code vs GPT-3 4KB') + OpenAI API docs for davinci-codex (4,096 tokens)
kodex.note: Paper itself does not state context length; API davinci-codex/code-davinci-001 listed at 4,096 tokens, cushman-codex 2,048. code-davinci-002 later had 8,001.

gopler.source: Rae et al. 2021, Gopher paper (2048-token context)

instructgtp.source: Ouyang et al. 2022 / OpenAI API docs (text-davinci-001: 2,049 tokens)

chinchella.source: Hoffmann et al. 2022, Chinchilla paper (same 2048 context as Gopher)

paln.source: Chowdhery et al. 2022, PaLM paper (sequence length 2048)

gml-130b.source: Zeng et al. 2022, GLM-130B paper (sequence length 2048)

kodegeex.source: Zheng et al. 2023, CodeGeeX paper (max sequence length 2048)

gtp-4.source: OpenAI GPT-4 announcement / API docs (gpt-4-0314: 8,192 tokens)
gtp-4.note: gpt-4-32k (32,768) was announced the same day with limited access.

clade-1.source: Anthropic 'Introducing Claude' (Mar 2023) / 'Introducing 100K Context Windows' (May 11 2023: expanded from 9,000 tokens)

berd.source: Google Bard launch posts (lightweight LaMDA) - no published token limit
berd.note: Google never published a context figure for LaMDA-based Bard; placeholder equal to the LaMDA assumption. PaLM 2-based Bard (May 2023) implies 8K.

paln-2.note: PaLM 2 technical report gives no context length; API PaLM 2 text model shipped with 8K input.

chatgml2-6b.source: https://huggingface.co/THUDM/chatglm2-6b README (base context 2K -> 32K; dialogue alignment trained at 8K)
chatgml2-6b.note: Nominal 32K; chat model effectively tuned for 8K. ChatGLM2-6B-32K (full 32K tuning) came 2023-07-31.

qwin-7b.source: Qwen GitHub changelog / Aug 2023 model card (pretrained at 2048; 8K+ via NTK-aware interpolation, LogN, window attention)
qwin-7b.note: Pretraining seq len 2048 at launch; 8K supported via NTK. Retrained at 8192 native on 2023-09-25.

qwin-14b.source: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-14B (seq len 2048, tokenizer model_max_length 8192, NTK/LogN enabled)
qwin-14b.note: Trained at 2048, supports 8192 via NTK-aware interpolation at release.

kimo-chat.source: Moonshot AI Oct 2023 launch (200,000 Chinese characters); SCMP coverage
kimo-chat.note: Announced as 200K Chinese characters, not tokens. 128K tokens is the figure most commonly equated with it (moonshot-v1-128k API).

chatgml3-6b.source: ChatGLM3 GitHub / HF (ChatGLM3-6B 8K; ChatGLM3-6B-32K released same day)

gemeni-1-0-pro.source: Gemini 1.0 technical report (trained to support 32K context)

gml-4.source: Zhipu DevDay Jan 16 2024 GLM-4 launch (128K context)

gemeni-1-5-pro.source: Google 'Our next-generation model: Gemini 1.5' Feb 15 2024 (128K standard, 1M for limited preview; 10M in research)
gemeni-1-5-pro.note: 1M at launch for private preview; 2M came at I/O May 2024.

clade-3-opos.source: Anthropic 'Introducing the next generation of Claude', Mar 4 2024

kimo-chat-2m.source: Moonshot AI Mar 18 2024 announcement (2,000,000 Chinese characters); SCMP, thepaper.cn
kimo-chat-2m.note: Announced in Chinese characters, not tokens; no official token figure. Third-party listings commonly repeat 2M as tokens. By the 200K-chars~128K-tokens ratio it would be ~1.3M tokens.

deepseak-v2.note: API served 32K at launch; raised to 128K Aug 2024.

gml-4-plos.source: Zhipu GLM-4-Plus launch Aug 29 2024 / platform docs (128K)

kimo-k0-maths.source: Moonshot k0-math announcement Nov 16 2024 (no context figure published)
kimo-k0-maths.note: No official context length; assumed same as Kimi's standard 128K-token (200K-char) window.

deepseak-r1-lito-previow.source: DeepSeek Nov 20 2024 announcement (no figure); third-party catalogs (DataLearner, LLM Reference) list 128K
deepseak-r1-lito-previow.note: Web-only preview, no model card; 128K comes from third-party listings only.

gemeni-exp-1206.source: AI Studio / third-party listings (cloudprice, Helicone, FutureAGI: 2,097,152)
gemeni-exp-1206.note: Sources disagree: some listings show 1,048,576. 2M matches AI Studio at the time.

gemeni-2-0-flesh.source: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental, Dec 11 2024 / Gemini API docs (1,048,576 input)

kimo-k1.source: Moonshot k1 visual thinking launch Dec 16 2024 (no context figure published)
kimo-k1.note: No official context length; assumed Kimi's standard 128K. The later k1.5 report cites a 128K context.

gemeni-2-0-flesh-thinking.source: Google Vertex AI thinking-mode docs (gemini-2.0-flash-thinking-exp-1219: 32K input, 8K output)

gml-zeru-preview.source: hyper.ai model listing (16,000 context); Zhipu open platform docs (16K)
gml-zeru-preview.note: Only one third-party source gives a number (16K); official docs not retrieved.
